2610.09976.title: EASE: Entropy-Adaptive Distribution Shaping for Evading AI-generated Text Detectors
2610.09976.paper_summary: AI-generated text (AIGT) detection can be sensitive to the decoding choices of the source large language model (LLM). We observe that perturbing next-token logits or adjusting sampling temperature can reduce detection performance, providing a clear signal of detector vulnerability to decoding-time distribution changes. Building on this observation, we propose EASE (Entropy-Adaptive Distribution Shaping for Evasion), a training-free and detector-agnostic framework for evading AIGT detectors. EASE computes predictive entropy directly from the source LLM's next-token distribution and uses it to adapt both logit perturbation and sampling temperature, without detector feedback or model fine-tuning. Experiments across three source LLMs and multiple detectors demonstrate consistent reductions in detection performance, with negligible degradation in text quality and negligible inference overhead.
2610.09976.paper_summary_zh: AI 生成文本 (AIGT) 的檢測對來源大型語言模型 (LLM) 的解碼選擇可能很敏感。<lb/>我們觀察到，擾動下一個標記的 logits 或調整採樣溫度可以降低檢測性能，這明確顯示了檢測器對解碼時間分佈變化的脆弱性。<lb/>基於這一觀察，我們提出了 EASE（適應性熵分佈塑形以規避），這是一個無需訓練且不依賴檢測器的框架，用於規避 AIGT 檢測器。<lb/>EASE 直接從來源 LLM 的下一個標記分佈計算預測熵，並利用它來調整 logits 擾動和採樣溫度，而無需檢測器反饋或模型微調。<lb/>在三個來源 LLM 和多個檢測器上進行的實驗顯示，檢測性能一致降低，文本質量幾乎沒有下降，推理開銷也幾乎可以忽略不計。
